description: REST API gateway (Apache APISIX) in front of your app, with gantry-auth verifying logins (Firebase, Cognito, Supabase, JWT or a custom authorizer). Configure routes and auth in the app's gateway.yml; with none it is a transparent proxy to `upstream`.

upstream.help: Where requests go when gateway.yml names no upstream: your app's base URL, without a path. localhost is reached through the Docker host.
